name: tldr
description: TL;DR for Claude Code: every turn as one card, with what to check.

card.title: Turn card
card.description: Fold each turn's tool calls into one card. Off: Claude Code draws its own rows, and trust, keep and actions turn off too.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The mode-aware spinner: what Claude does now, and a moving frame by mode.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Moving frames and short pulses. Off: motion keeps static colors only.

context.title: Context bar
context.description: A bar above the prompt: what fills the context window, by category, and how much is left. /tldr context lists it.

trust.title: Trust flags
trust.description: Flag what to check: test files changed to pass, writes outside the project, deletes, skipped tests, --no-verify or force push.

keep.title: Keep cards
keep.description: Save finished cards so they stay after /compact and a resume. /tldr history lists them.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: /tldr copy and /tldr diff, and the same as buttons on the card.
